newsitem.title: CANADA: Enscor to sell C$5.8 mln stake in project.
newsitem.headline: Enscor to sell C$5.8 mln stake in project.

text.p: Enscor Inc said on Wednesday it entered into an agreement to sell its interest in a Whitby, Ontario development project for C$5.8 million cash.
Closing is slated for April 1997, Enscor said.

The Whitby project represents Enscor's last remaining active development site. The company's remaining active operations include the Best Western Hidden Vally Resort Hotel in Huntsville, Ontario and Hayden Industrial Cooling Products of Corona, California, which manufactures and supplies heat exchange products for industrial and vehicular original equipment manufacturers.

Enscor said it has no plans to sell either business but a number of options for the redeployment of Enscor's remaining liquid assets are under consideration and it is anticipated that a plan will be adopted prior to the July 1997 year end.
